affected.note: Ranked by the largest single figure published (28,433) because no overall total was given. Published figures at Harima-Yamasaki Post Office (Hyogo): 28,433 Yu-Pack, 11,080 registered mail, 2,919 Letter Pack Plus, 245 international mail and EMS, 36 restricted-delivery. Japan Post said it could not identify and contact affected customers individually.

summary.en: Japan Post said 42,713 post office copies of delivery records for Yu-Pack parcels, registered mail and other items had gone missing at Harima-Yamasaki Post Office in Hyogo Prefecture. The documents contain sender and recipient names, addresses and phone numbers, and in some cases ID document numbers.
summary.ja: 日本郵便は、兵庫県の播磨山崎郵便局で、ゆうパックや書留郵便物などを配達した際の郵便局控え42,713件が所在不明になったと公表した。控えには差出人や受取人の氏名、住所、電話番号のほか、一部に本人確認書類の番号などが記載されている。
